embeds.title: 🟡 Grafana Labs Confirms Codebase Theft by CoinbaseCartel, Refuses Ransom
embeds.description:
**Actor:** CoinbaseCartel
Grafana Labs confirmed on Saturday that an unauthorized party obtained a token with access to their GitHub environment and downloaded the company's codebase. The extortion group CoinbaseCartel claimed responsibility for the theft and attempted to blackmail Grafana Labs, but the company refused to pay the ransom. Grafana Labs stated that no customer data or personal information was accessed during the incident and found no evidence of impact to customer systems or operations.
